summary: A Google product lead posted that Gemini on Android can automate actions across more than 40 popular apps, citing examples like booking rides and reserving tables, with further updates teased for the next day's Made by Google event.

mechanisms.reason: The post states Gemini can autonomously perform in-app actions like booking and reserving across dozens of apps, which is agent-executed task delegation rather than manual seat use.
mechanisms.quote: Gemini can automate actions across 40+ popular apps

practices.reason: An engineering team building consumer or agentic app integrations would want to evaluate this cross-app action automation capability before relying on it.
practices.quote: Gemini can automate actions across 40+ popular apps
